title: 第9章 稳固境界与后手第10章 灭门前夕
slug: 苟道剑尊从反夺舍老祖开始长生
content_zh:
矿洞深处，阴冷潮湿。
林渊盘坐在那条微弱的一阶灵脉分支上，周身泛着淡淡的金芒。
液化后的灵力在经脉中缓缓流淌，每运转一个周天，丹田内那滴如水银般沉重的筑基灵液便会凝实一分。
修仙界常言，筑基如跃龙门，不仅是生命层次的跃迁，更是根基的重塑。
若是寻常炼气九层修士侥幸突破，少说也得闭关数月甚至半年，方能让暴涨的灵力与肉身彻底契合。
但林渊不同，他脑海中有着林老祖两百年的修仙经验。
老鬼当年虽然是个邪修，但好歹也是筑基后期的大修，对于筑基期各境界的灵力运转、气血调理，却是熟稔无比。
“呼——”
林渊睁开双眼，一道寸许长的金芒从眸中一闪而逝，将昏暗的矿洞映射得一片通亮。
历时三日，他的筑基初期境界，总算是彻底稳固了下来。
林渊闭上眼，神识如潮水般向外蔓延，周遭乱石的纹路、滴水的频率，都清晰地倒映在脑海之中，比之三日前更加稳定。
炼气期神识不过十丈，如今暴涨二十倍，这便是筑基修士能御器飞行的底气所在。
“还不够万无一失——”
林渊呢喃一声，从储物袋中取出那柄通体乌黑的玄金剑。
这本是林老祖的本命法器，二阶中品，因老鬼神魂俱灭，剑身上的神识烙印已成了无源之水。
“疾！”
林渊并指如刀，一口精纯的灵力喷在剑身上。
他本就是单金灵根，所修的《玄金诀》与这柄飞剑属性完美契合，再加上老祖记忆中关于此剑的祭炼手法，不过短短一日，黑剑便发出一声欢快的轻吟，化作一道墨芒在矿洞内穿梭如电。
“虽然灵性跌落，只能发挥出二阶下品的威能，但配合我如今的筑基灵力，斩杀一般炼气期修士，如剪草芥。”
林渊满意地点了点头，随即收起飞剑。

接下来，临走前再捞一笔。
林家覆灭在即，他可不打算给这个烂透了的家族陪葬，但火中取栗的准备工作，必须做到极致。
他将目光投向了林家前山的方向——林家宝库。
老祖的记忆中，林家数百年积攒的灵石、药材，有大半都堆放在那座由二阶九天玄金阵守护的宝库中。
那阵法虽然厉害，但作为林家真正的主人，老祖当年为了防备嫡系长老中饱私囊，在宝库背阴处的一处通风口上，暗中留下了一道隔绝灵力波动的阵法漏洞，便于他随时查探。
“陈、刘两家攻山之时，便是地脉灵气大乱之日。届时，这处漏洞会维持三息的溃散状态，那便是我火中取栗的机会。”
林渊藏在阴影里，手指轻轻摩挲着下巴，眼神平静。
清晨，阳光穿过破旧的窗棂，照进林渊位于旁系区域的小院里。
他将修为死死压制在炼气九层，面色依旧带着一抹虚弱的苍白，坐在院中的石凳上翻看着一本杂书。
“渊哥！渊哥在吗？”
门外传来一阵怯生生的喊声。
来人是一名年约十六岁的少女，穿着一身洗得发白的粗布长裙，小脸冻得有些通红。
正是林小婉，林家旁系中的一个普通凡人。
在修仙世家里，没有灵根的旁系子弟，地位甚至不如嫡系豢养的一条灵犬，只能充当仆役或者在农田里打杂。
林渊幼时父母双亡，在尚未检测出灵根最凄惨的那几年，曾险些在冰天雪地里冻死，是林小婉偷偷从厨房省下了一碗热腾腾的灵薯饭，这才让他熬过了那个寒冬。
这份恩情，林渊一直记在心里。
后来他检测出金灵根，成了林家眼中的天才，地位水涨船高，也曾暗中照拂过林小婉一家，让他们免受那些恶奴的欺凌。
“小婉？”
林渊收起杂书，推开院门，只见林小婉正站在门外，手里还提着一个竹篮，里面装满了刚出土、洗得干干净净的灵薯。
content_en:
Deep in the mine, it is cold and damp.
Lin Yuan sat cross-legged on the weak first-order spiritual vein branch, with a faint golden light glowing all over his body.
The liquefied spiritual power flows slowly in the meridians. Every time it circulates, the drop of foundation-building spiritual fluid as heavy as mercury in the dantian will solidify.
As the saying goes in the world of immortality, building a foundation is like leaping through a dragon gate. It is not only a leap in the level of life, but also a reshaping of the foundation.
If an ordinary ninth-level Qi refining monk were lucky enough to break through, he would have to stay in seclusion for several months or even half a year to fully integrate his soaring spiritual power with his physical body.
But Lin Yuan was different. He had Patriarch Lin's two hundred years of experience in cultivating immortals in his mind.
Although the old ghost was an evil cultivator back then, he was still a major cultivator in the later stage of Foundation Establishment. He was extremely familiar with the movement of spiritual power and the regulation of Qi and blood in various realms during the Foundation Establishment stage.
"Huh——"
Lin Yuan opened his eyes, and an inch-long golden light flashed from his eyes, illuminating the dim mine.
After three days, his initial stage of foundation building was finally completely stabilized.
Lin Yuan closed his eyes, and his consciousness spread outward like a tide. The texture of the surrounding rocks and the frequency of dripping water were clearly reflected in his mind, which was more stable than three days ago.
During the Qi refining period, the spiritual consciousness was only ten feet, but now it has increased twenty times. This is the foundation building monk's confidence to fly with weapons.
"Not foolproof enough—"
Lin Yuan murmured and took out the black gold sword from the storage bag.
This was the natal magic weapon of Patriarch Lin, a second-level mid-grade weapon. Because the spirit and soul of the old ghost were all destroyed, the brand of divine consciousness on the sword has become sourceless water.
"Disease!"
Lin Yuan pointed his fingers like a sword, and sprayed a mouthful of pure spiritual power on the sword.
He originally had a single-gold spiritual root, and the "Xuanjin Jue" he cultivated perfectly matched the attributes of this flying sword. Coupled with the ancestor's memory of the sword's sacrificial techniques, in just one day, the black sword let out a cheerful whisper and turned into a black light that shuttled through the mine like electricity.
"Although my spiritual power has fallen and I can only exert the power of the second-level low-grade, with my current foundation-building spiritual power, I can kill ordinary monks in the Qi refining stage like a mustard."
Lin Yuan nodded with satisfaction and then put away the flying sword.
Next, make one more profit before you leave.
The Lin family was about to be destroyed, and he had no intention of being buried with this rotten family, but the preparations for taking chestnuts from the fire must be done to the extreme.
He set his sights in the direction of the Lin family's front mountain - the Lin family's treasure house.
In the memory of the ancestor, most of the spiritual stones and medicinal materials accumulated by the Lin family for hundreds of years were piled in the treasure house guarded by the second-order Nine Heavens Mysterious Gold Formation.
Although the formation was powerful, as the true master of the Lin family, the ancestor secretly left a loophole in the formation in a vent in the shade of the treasure house to isolate the fluctuations of spiritual power in order to prevent the direct elders from enriching their own pockets, so that he could investigate at any time.
"When the Chen and Liu families attack the mountain, it will be a day when the earth's spiritual energy will be in chaos. At that time, this loophole will maintain a state of collapse for three breaths, and that will be my opportunity to draw chestnuts from the fire."
Lin Yuan hid in the shadows, gently rubbing his chin with his fingers, his eyes calm.
In the early morning, the sun shines through the dilapidated window lattice into Lin Yuan's small courtyard in the side area.
He suppressed his cultivation to the ninth level of Qi Refining, his face still looked pale and weak, and he sat on the stone bench in the courtyard and read a miscellaneous book.
"Brother Yuan! Is Brother Yuan here?"
There was a timid shout from outside the door.
The person who came was a girl about sixteen years old, wearing a long coarse cloth dress that had been washed white, and her face was a little red from the cold.
It was Lin Xiaowan, an ordinary mortal from a branch of the Lin family.
In a family of cultivators, collateral descendants without spiritual roots are not even as good as a spiritual dog raised by a direct descendant, and can only serve as servants or do odd jobs in the farmland.
Lin Yuan's parents died when he was young. In the most miserable years before his spiritual roots were detected, he almost froze to death in the ice and snow. It was Lin Xiaowan who secretly saved a bowl of hot food from the kitchen.Sweet potato rice allowed him to survive the cold winter.
Lin Yuan always kept this kindness in his heart.
Later, he detected the golden spirit root and became a genius in the eyes of the Lin family. His status increased rapidly, and he also secretly took care of Lin Xiaowan's family to protect them from the bullying of those evil slaves.
"Xiaowan?"
Lin Yuan put away the miscellaneous books and pushed open the courtyard door, only to see Lin Xiaowan standing outside the door, holding a bamboo basket filled with freshly unearthed and washed spiritual potatoes.
